title: Vertical bone augmentation in a single-tooth gap with an allogenic bone ring: Clinical considerations
authors: Giesenhagen B, Martin N, Donkiewicz P , Perić Kačarević Ž, Smeets R, Jung O, Schnettler R, Barbeck M. J Esthet Restor Dent. 2018 Nov;30(6):480-483. doi: 10.1111/jerd.12392.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft bonering (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The report demonstrates the time-saving and successful application of this treatment concept, which has the potential to increase patient satisfaction and comfort” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
